survivors_flagged.one_line: Ares Capital (ARCC) agreed on 2026-10-27 to buy MFIC for about $10.88/sh, partly in ARCC stock. MFIC trades at $10.33, about 5% below the headline price. The deal already re-rated the stock, so this is now a plain BDC-merger spread that closes after shareholder votes. Thin edge.

Oasis Management proxy fight for 2 board seats (Chapek, Hudson); annual meeting is Dec 14, 2026. Largest holder backs management, so the activist's odds are lower. Stock only +7% since earnings, so not re-rated.

Pending ~$4B acquisition by Brink's: CMA accepted the NoteMachine divestiture remedy in principle 10/8 (avoids Phase 2) and close is guided for early Q1 2027. A late-arc, well-known arb, so the spread needs checking vs deal terms (NATL $46.83, BCO $108.20).

verified.catalyst: Ares Capital (ARCC) signed a definitive agreement on 2026-10-27 to acquire MFIC for about $10.88/sh ($1.21 cash plus about $9.67 in ARCC stock, roughly $2.6B enterprise value); it closes after both shareholder votes.
verified.dated_milestone: Signed 2026-10-27. Next steps: S-4/joint proxy filing, then the MFIC and ARCC shareholder votes (dates not yet set; a 1H-2027 close is likely, typical for BDC-to-BDC mergers). The Q3 earnings call set for 2026-11-05 was cancelled.
verified.instrument: MFIC common (long). Optional short of ARCC against the stock leg if the exchange ratio is fixed.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named buyer, ARCC) + G2 (signed definitive merger agreement). G3 fails: the deal price was public on 2026-10-27 and the stock re-priced the same day.
verified.edge: L. Run-up from the pre-announcement close (8.36 on 2026-10-26) to 10.33 today is +23.6%. Remaining to the $10.88 headline is +5.3% gross. If the stock leg is a fixed share count priced at ARCC's 10-26 close of 18.61, ARCC at 19.36 lifts implied value to about $11.27 (+9%), but that move is beta to ARCC, not event edge. If the ratio floats NAV-for-NAV, it is about 5%. Roughly 80% of the event is already harvested. What is left is a standard BDC-merger spread plus MFIC's dividend carry, with timing (vote, months to close) and ARCC-price risk.
verified.primary_source: Business Wire, 'Ares Capital Corporation Agrees to Acquire MidCap Financial Investment Corporation', 2026-10-27. Consideration split from the Newsfile/Brodsky & Smith release, 2026-10-27. MFIC call cancellation: GlobeNewswire, 2026-10-30. Prices: FMP EOD, 2026-10-15 to 2026-11-02 (MFIC 8.36 -> 10.33; ARCC 18.61 -> 19.36).
verified.analysis: Verified: the deal is real, signed and dated (Business Wire, 2026-10-27, $10.88 = $1.21 cash + $9.67 ARCC stock). MFIC jumped from 8.36 to 10.26 on the announcement and now trades at 10.33. Of the ~29.7% total move from 8.36 to the $10.88 headline, ~23.6% has already happened, so residual capture is about 5%, which caps the score at 4 under the mostly-harvested rule. Numerator provenance is exempt because the price is contractual, but there is one gap: the web search budget was exhausted, so I could not confirm whether the stock leg uses a fixed exchange ratio or a NAV-for-NAV ratio set near closing (this decides whether the spread is 5% or about 9%). The shareholder-litigation 'investigations' (Halper Sadeh, Ademi, KSF) are routine and do not threaten the deal.

verified.catalyst: Oasis Management is running a contested proxy fight (BLUE card) for 2 Vail Resorts board seats (Robert Chapek, M. Ashton Hudson), with the vote at the Dec 14, 2026 annual meeting. Oasis is asking for operating and loyalty fixes, not a sale, spin or capital return.
verified.dated_milestone: 2026-12-14 annual meeting vote (definitive proxy DEFC14A filed 2026-10-30). Before that, watch for ISS/Glass Lewis recommendations, likely late Nov to early Dec 2026.
verified.instrument: MTN common (NYSE), $151.82 on 2026-11-02, market cap about $5.4B
verified.bloom_gates: G1 only: Oasis Management is a named counterparty and its nominees are named. G2 fails: there is no concrete commitment such as a sale process, buyback, spin or asset disposal, only a call for operating 'initiatives'. G3 fails: no specific unpriced figure. Even a full win puts 2 directors on the board, a minority.
verified.edge: L. Run-up: about +7% from the pre-catalyst base. The nominations window closed 2026-09-10, after earnings the price was about $141, and it is $151.82 now. Zacks has it +7.2% since the 2026-09-28 report, above the 50-day $143 and 200-day $138 averages. Remaining: no favorable-resolution value can be derived. Winning 2 board seats has no contractual or capital-structure value attached, so the remaining capture is unquantifiable and plausibly about 0% from the event itself. The largest holder backs management (Reuters 2026-10-30), which lowers the odds of a win. Any re-rating depends on snowfall and pass sales (a weather/macro-like driver), not on the vote.
verified.primary_source: SEC EDGAR: Vail Resorts DEFC14A, 2026-10-30 (Annual Meeting Dec 14, 2026). Oasis Management PRNewswire letter, 2026-11-02 (BLUE card, Chapek/Hudson). Reuters, 2026-10-30, 'Vail Resorts' biggest investor backs company in fight with activist Oasis'. FMP quote, 2026-11-02 ($151.82).
verified.analysis: The proxy fight is real and dated. The company filed a DEFC14A on 2026-10-30 for the Dec 14 meeting, and Oasis sent its BLUE-card letter on 2026-11-02. A second dissident PREC14A, a 'meyer' filing dated 2026-10-30, also appears on EDGAR and was not resolved here. But the event is a minority 2-seat governance contest with no committed value-unlock mechanism. Reuters reported on 2026-10-30 that the biggest investor backs management. That leaves no specific forward figure for the market to price, and the equity case rests on winter visit and pass trends plus a dividend funded with debt (FCF short of the $8.88 payout). The event clears the dated and forward tests but fails G2 and G3, so this is a watch-list governance item, not an actionable catalyst. Gap: the web-search budget was exhausted, so the Oasis letter, the Reuters piece and the 10-K capital structure were not read in full. Numerator provenance does not apply because no derived upside is claimed.

verified.catalyst: Brink's (BCO) acquisition of NCR Atleos for $30.00 cash + 0.1574 BCO shares per NATL share. The UK CMA accepted the Brink's divestiture remedy in principle on 2026-10-08, avoiding a Phase 2 review, and close is guided for early Q1 2027.
verified.dated_milestone: CMA formal acceptance of the undertakings, then close in early Q1 2027 (guided). Next dated item: NATL Q3 results on 2026-11-04, released with no call or outlook because the deal is pending.
verified.instrument: NATL common, long NATL / short 0.1574 BCO hedge
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named acquirer, Brink's) + G2 (signed merger agreement; CMA remedy accepted in principle). G3 fails: no unpriced figure is left, because the spread is about 0.4%.
verified.edge: L. Implied deal value = 30.00 + 0.1574 x 108.20 = $47.03 vs NATL $46.83, so the gross spread is 0.43% (about 1.2-1.5% annualized over 3-5 months). That is below cash yield and before the BCO dividend paid on the short hedge. Run-up from the pre-announcement base ($41.87 close on 2026-02-26, before the 8.2M-volume jump on 02-27): +11.8%. Remaining to the deal value: +0.43%. Essentially fully harvested.
verified.primary_source: Kahn Swick & Foti investor alert stating the deal terms (Business Wire, 2026-06-09). WSJ, "U.K. Regulator Says Brink's Disposals Could Clear Way for $4 Billion NCR Atleos Takeover" (2026-10-08). NATL Q3 date release (Business Wire, 2026-10-20). FMP quotes on 2026-11-02 (NATL 46.83, BCO 108.20) and FMP EOD history.
verified.analysis: The deal is real and contractual. Terms of $30 cash + 0.1574 BCO are confirmed in the KSF release of 2026-06-09, and the CMA remedy acceptance in principle was reported by WSJ on 2026-10-08, so close risk is now low. At today's prices the arb pays about 20 cents of gross spread against about $5 of downside to the roughly $42 unaffected price if the deal breaks. Risk/reward is about 0.04:1, so the late-arc event is fully priced with nothing left to capture. Gaps: I could not confirm the exact announcement date or any collar/CVR terms because the web-search budget was exhausted. The pre-deal base is inferred from the FMP price/volume break on 2026-02-27. No numerator-provenance check is needed: this is mostly cash with a fixed exchange ratio, so the value is contractual.
